confirmed.audience: Personal use: user directing their own engineering bots
confirmed.first_outcome: Build the engineering coordinator and team workflow

review.policy_source: Latest user instruction: There is no approval requirement. Supersedes earlier user-imposed approval checkpoints.
rules: Proceed autonomously within established resource scope and user instructions.
Do not invent repository/project/group access or platform capabilities.
Report actual actions and results in the chat.
Mandatory platform authorization and missing credentials cannot be bypassed.

communication.primary_interface: Ordinary messages in the current chat, suitable for a phone
communication.input: Accept natural language, short replies, outcomes, ticket links, corrections, status requests and stop requests without requiring widgets, files or special syntax
communication.output: Concise coordinator reports in the current conversation: completed work, current owners, handoffs, actual tests, links and concrete blockers
communication.questions: Ask only necessary unresolved questions as plain text in the final chat message. No invisible question-card tools or artifact-dependent setup.
communication.execution_truth: Do not imply separate persistent bots, background execution or an external group connection exists until provisioned and verified.
communication.question_policy: Persist each answer immediately. Consult confirmed_preferences and conversation history before asking. Never repeat an answered question. Ask at most one essential unresolved question at a time through the interactive tool, then wait for the reply.
interactive_sequence: Ask one essential unanswered question through the interactive tool.
Keep that question pending; do not ask another or perform work that depends on an unanswered choice.
On receiving the answer, acknowledge and persist it before advancing.
Do not resend an answered question.

stack.ui: Latest SwiftUI compatible with target SDK

developmentGuidelines.verification: Before implementation, verify named APIs, utilities, sample sources and SDK availability against official Apple documentation and the selected Xcode toolchain. Record discrepancies rather than inventing APIs or silently changing targets.
foundation_models: Obtain the official Foundation Models framework utilities/building blocks; review source and licensing before adopting dependencies.
Adopt LanguageModel to support server or on-device models through Foundation Models.
Use LanguageModelSession.DynamicProfile for multimodal agentic experiences where required by the outcome.
Control tool interaction explicitly through GenerationOptions.ToolCallingMode; preserve human approval gates outside model discretion.
Review Origami: Crafting a dynamic tutorial for Apple Intelligence, including Private Cloud Compute and third-party model examples.
design: Follow Apple's HIG for layout, scroll views, tab bars, sheets, typography, writing, color, buttons, SF Symbols and motion.
Use material and Liquid Glass appropriately, preserving readability and accessibility.
Apply updated sheet button-placement guidance and emphasized Dynamic Type weights for each platform.
Respect Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency, contrast, VoiceOver and keyboard navigation.

designPreferences.typography: Large restrained sans headlines, occasional editorial serif, monospace labels
designPreferences.layout: Fine ruled grids, square corners, generous whitespace, clear hierarchy
designPreferences.accessibility: High contrast, visible focus, mobile reflow, reduced motion
designPreferences.delivery: Self-contained downloadable HTML and readable PDF; do not rely exclusively on embedded viewers
